   159	def points(entry, result):

   161	    first = entry["lexical"]

   163	        need(link["path"] == first, "link_chain_binding")
   164	        value = full_stat(os.lstat(first))
   165	        need(value["st_mode"] & 0o170000 == 0o120000, "expected_symlink")
   166	        target = os.readlink(first)

   168	        need(target == link["target"], "unexpected_link_target")
